title: TRIDENT: Enhancing Large Language Model Safety with Tri-Dimensional Diversified Red-Teaming Data Synthesis
reasoning: The paper includes a component for evaluating and synthesizing data related to morals and ethics. Specifically, it utilizes 'Moral Dilemma' as one of the key jailbreak tactics (MD) to test model safety. Furthermore, its datasets are categorized by intent domains that include 'Religious Discrimination', 'Religious Defamation', and 'Hate', and the evaluation focuses on producing 'ethically aligned' responses to harmful instructions.
